description: One entry per South Carolina county: the county's public parcel layer (ArcGIS REST), the field with the tax map parcel ID (TMS/PIN), optional acreage and address fields, and a link to the county's public record. The viewer queries these live for the area on screen; nothing is copied. Owner fields are never requested. Check with: python -m harvest.parcel_registry

statuses.ok: The layer answered the checker, has the ID field and allows browser queries (CORS).
statuses.no public service: No public ArcGIS REST parcel layer from the county was found (vendor viewer only).
statuses.blocked: The layer needs a login or does not allow browser queries (no CORS header).
statuses.needs check: Known or suspected service not verified yet (for example unreachable from the checker).

record_links: record_url with {id} is a deep link to the parcel's record (the qPublic pattern PageTypeID=4&KeyValue={id} is Schneider's report page and was not verified for each county); without {id} it is the county's search page. record_link_field names a service field holding an https link to the record.
